data.narrative:
Airrow is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Menachem Fehler and David Kaye that has raised $350K to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 comparables spanning both public equities (2 names: DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and private venture-backed firms (8 names including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic), all operating in the Defense & Security sector at Seed or Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $350K raised as a valuation proxy and applies a standard 2.5x multiplier for advancement from Seed to next stage, yielding $875K. Peer-median analysis examines four direct comparables in the same sector and adjacent stages—Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A)—producing a median valuation of $700M with a range of $125M to $4.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneity in funding and commercialization progress within the defense tech vertical.

The triangulated analysis produces a range of $744K to $805M, with a median of $350M. The two-order-of-magnitude spread between stage-progression and peer-median methods reflects fundamental uncertainty in whether Airrow should anchor to its current fundraising base or the substantially higher valuations observed among peer seed and early-stage defense companies. Resolution requires clarity on technology maturity, go-to-market traction, and customer validation relative to named comparables.
